advance_dropped.why: approach shorter than 150 m or no clear post

built_up.classification: ADR 0279 D33: D-42..D-43 (OSM, else BDOT10k rule); kerb not used

embankment_check.ground: NMT (decks removed) at the profile end + 5 / 7 / 9 m

limit_signs.rule: ADR 0307: B-16 / B-18 15 m before a bridge / tunnel with maxheight / maxweight in roads.graph.json

garden_fronts.source: research/g7-street-greenery/README.md (G7 # 15-21); positions are rule, not survey

garden_trees.source: crowns: GUGiK orthophoto 2024 (plot_canopy.json); habit / height: G7 # 6-7, 11-14

mesh_budget.note: frame estimate = chunks/instances within 1.6 km in a 120 deg wedge (everything within 200 m), no occlusion culling; forest HLOD cells beyond forest_hlod_m replace their trees; docs/06 par. 6 hypotheses: Low <= 400-600 k tris, High <= 1.5-2 M

farmland.encoding: COLOR_0.b flag (0.90 grassland, 1.00 arable), mosaic per pixel (ADR 0298)
farmland.layout: ESTIMATED strips (no cadastral parcels in the repo)
